written.headline: UN talks fail to produce binding rules for autonomous weapons
written.summary: UN diplomats meeting in Geneva failed to establish legally binding rules for autonomous weapons, agreeing instead to spend two more years discussing options. Major military powers including Russia, the United States, and Israel obstructed stronger measures during the weeklong conference.

written.headline: Tesla rolls out FSD v15 with real-time AI rendering and December wide release
written.summary: Tesla has rolled out Full Self-Driving (FSD) v15 to some vehicles, featuring a visualization system that provides a photorealistic rendering of car surroundings. CEO Elon Musk stated that the new version will go wide next month with the 2026 Holiday Update.

written.headline: Li Ming central to smuggling restricted AI chips from Southeast Asia to China
written.summary: Alice Huang associate Li Ming, whom Singapore charged with fraud in 2025, was central to smuggling restricted AI chips from Southeast Asia to China. The development follows Nvidia's ouster of CEO Jensen Huang and the company's decision to stop selling H200 chips in China.

written.headline: CJI Surya Kant urges AI disclosure guidelines for legal research
written.summary: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant urged the Commonwealth Legal Education Association to create model guidelines for disclosing AI assistance in legal research. He also cautioned against relying solely on AI detection software due to its potential errors.

written.headline: AI server suppliers demand higher prices after contracts signed
written.summary: AI server suppliers such as Dell, HPE, Lenovo, and Supermicro are demanding higher prices from buyers months after contracts were signed. The price increases reach up to 45%.

written.headline: Parshu Tactical Defence trains Indian Navy officers in LLM fine-tuning
written.summary: Parshu Tactical Defence trained more than 56 Indian Navy officers in hands-on fine-tuning of large language models during a three-day workshop at INS Valsura. Every participating officer successfully launched, trained, and deployed a model by the close of the session.
